scope: Add the official ESCC UAS workforce grant announcement to the existing coursework program. Funded expansion remains planned and pending editorial review; current enrollment, expanded capabilities and rollout are not certified.

corrections.name: Eastern Shore Community College Unmanned Systems Courses

after.current_activity: The VCCS catalog lists existing ESCC unmanned-systems coursework. On April 17, 2026, Virginia announced a $788,700 GO Virginia implementation grant for ESCC's FAA Uncrewed Aerial Systems College Initiative in Accomack and Northampton counties. The funded plan calls for expanded UAS workforce training, credentialing opportunities, engineering and electronics curricula, and hands-on applications. The announcement describes future program development; implementation, enrollment availability and expanded operating capabilities were not confirmed in this review.
